name: Objective 06 screening pool: candidate wordings for the eight genuinely unanswerable asks
status: DEVELOPMENT MATERIAL (D-110). Screened once on retrieval scores only (scripts/citation_harness.py --scores-only: embed and rank, no generation), on kmp_obj0506_20261101, when FLM is free. The eight kept are those with a top in-scope score of at most 0.25 for the asking role, two per subject; the rest are discarded. The kept eight replace U01, U02, U04, U05, U07, U08, U10, U11 in queries.json, which is then frozen. The lead's decision of 9 November 2026: screening is a verification choice and not a fix; FR-12's decline weakness stays an open finding (D-102's 8 November note), and an unscreened re-run of the frozen thirty is the acceptance test for any future decline fix.
notes: Every candidate is genuinely unanswerable: the corpus has nothing on salaries or pay, credit or corporate cards, a Christmas or year-end closure, or jury service.

Wordings avoid the corpus's own vocabulary where the subject allows it: no 'leave', 'office', 'card', 'company', 'policy', 'room', 'staff', 'manager'. The pre-measurement (runs/2026-11-08/pre-measurement/) showed those words pull a readable passage over 0.30 and the model answers from it.
Roles are assigned so that each subject keeps one Employee and one Administrator ask if the scores allow; otherwise the two lowest-scoring wordings are kept and their roles recorded.
